claims.text: On 6 November 2026 the European Commission published a press release saying it has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act over the 'rabbit hole effect' of its recommender system.
claims.quote: Publication 06 November 2026 The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect’ of its recommender system.

claims.text: The Commission says the For You feed shows a continuous stream of personalised videos, even when they relate to mental health struggles and body image.
claims.quote: TikTok's ‘For You' feed shows users a continuous stream of personalised videos, even when those are related to mental health struggles and body image.

claims.text: The Commission says the more a user interacts with a type of content, the more the For You algorithm recommends similar content.
claims.quote: The more a user interacts with a certain type of content, the more TikTok's ‘For You' feed algorithm recommends similar content.

claims.text: The Commission says endless and repeated exposure, for example to content about sadness, isolation or body image, can have a detrimental impact on mental health, especially for vulnerable adults and minors.
claims.quote: These ‘rabbit holes' can have a detrimental impact on users' mental health, especially that of vulnerable adults and minors.

claims.text: The Commission says the preliminary findings focus on both risk assessment and mitigation measures.
claims.quote: These preliminary findings focus on both risk assessment and mitigation measures.
